references.text: The same principle of uncleanness by touching a bed or an object that an unclean person has lain on or sat on.
Parallel text regarding the woman's menstruation and the uncleanness associated with her bed and what she sits on.
The same legal principle applied to prolonged bleeding outside the time of menstruation.
General principle of uncleanness until evening by touching unclean things.
Uncleanness until evening resulting from touch, with the same timeframe for cleansing.
